coachMessages.text: The J-Shape: an L-shaped cluster of 4 discs creating three winning continuations. Your opponent can block one, maybe two — but not all three.

slides.infoProse: Five Yellow discs form a compact cluster across columns 0-4. The key cells unlock threats in three directions: a diagonal through the center, and horizontal continuations at either end of row 2. Blocking one or two still leaves the third.

coachMessages.text: With threats in three directions (diagonal, horizontal-center, horizontal-right), the opponent needs three moves to block all of them. They only get one.

slides.infoProse: Three winning cells, one move to set them up. The J-Shape is the most powerful attacking formation in Connect Four.
